verdict.rationale: Conta Simples' own API reference documents an interactive playground next to each endpoint for testing calls, and endpoint reference pages such as the corporate-cards listing are present. That covers both an interactive reference and runnable calls. missing for 10: no explicit evidence of prefilled example requests or code samples in multiple languages, no hands-on or independent confirmation that the playground works, and no publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
